name: hold-to-confirm
title: Hold to Confirm
description: Button that runs onConfirm only after a full press-and-hold by mouse, touch or keyboard, rewinds on early release, shows "Hold to confirm" on a plain click, and lets users who can't hold (screen reader, switch access) confirm with a second press.

meta.stops: Helps prevent a destructive action fired by a stray click
meta.summary: A button that fires only after a full press-and-hold, so a stray click or tap doesn't trigger a destructive action.
meta.server: Authorize the destructive action on the server and make it idempotent.
catches: Stray click or tap on a delete or other irreversible button
Plain click: a hint explains to hold
Users who can't hold: a second press confirms instead
limits: Friction, not authorization: anyone who holds it confirms
The second-press path is quicker than holding, by design
Doesn't name the target; pair it with clear wording or a readback
a11y: Native button; Space or Enter can be held from the keyboard
Hint text is linked via aria-describedby and status changes use role=status
aria-busy while onConfirm is pending; icons are aria-hidden
Fill and label animations are reduced under reduced motion
